title: Export a WRDS table to Parquet, skipping if already up to date — wrds_update_pq
text: table_name Name table WRDS PostgreSQL database. schema Name database schema (e.g. "crsp", "comp"). data_dir Root directory local Parquet data repository. Defaults DATA_DIR environment variable, interactive setup needed. output file written <data_dir>/<schema>/<table_name>.parquet. out_file Optional. Full path output Parquet file. Overrides path derived data_dir, schema, table_name. force TRUE, download proceeds regardless date comparison result. Optional SQL clause (without keyword) filter rows export. example, = "date > '2020-01-01'". obs Optional integer. Limits number rows imported using SQL LIMIT. Useful testing large tables (e.g. obs = 1000). keep Optional character vector regex patterns. columns whose names match least one pattern retained. Applied drop. drop Optional character vector regex patterns. Columns whose names match least one pattern removed. Applied keep. rename Optional named character vector list mapping source column names output column names. col_types names refer output names renaming. alt_table_name Optional. Alternative basename output Parquet file, used file different name table_name. chunk_size Number rows fetched written per chunk. omitted, defaults 100000 transfer_method = "dbi" 250000 transfer_method = "adbc". col_types Optional named list specifying column type overrides. Values may string type names (e.g. "int32", "float32", "date") Arrow DataType objects. columns need differ inferred types need supplied. See col_types = list(permno = "int32", ret = "float32"). String names "int32", "float32", "date", "timestamp", "timestamptz" supported. tz Time zone used interpret TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE columns. columns cast TIMESTAMPTZ SQL query using TIME ZONE, written UTC-normalised timestamps Parquet file. Defaults "UTC". Set NULL leave naive timestamps -. archive TRUE, existing local Parquet file () moved archive subdirectory replaced. archived filename <table>_<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSz>.parquet, timestamp suffix derived last_modified metadata embedded existing file (.e. date last downloaded, incoming WRDS table comment). archive_dir Name archive subdirectory relative schema directory. Defaults "archive". use_sas TRUE, last-modified date obtained running PROC CONTENTS SAS dataset via SSH, rather reading PostgreSQL table comment. Requires ssh package SSH key access wrds-cloud-sshkey.wharton.upenn.edu. sas_schema SAS library name use use_sas = TRUE. Defaults schema. encoding Character encoding passed PROC CONTENTS use_sas = TRUE. Default "utf-8". wrds_id WRDS user ID used SSH connection use_sas = TRUE. Defaults WRDS_ID environment variable. transfer_method Transfer backend used SQL--Parquet step. Use "dbi" existing DBI/data-frame path "adbc" experimental ADBC/Arrow path. numeric_mode Numeric handling mode PostgreSQL numeric columns. default "decimal" transfers values text writes bounded numeric(p, s) columns Arrow decimals. Use "float64" cast values DOUBLE PRECISION fetching, "text" retain text values, "raw" keep transfer backend's default representation.
